source.title: India’s vehicle scrapping framework may soon become more regulated and digitally monitored.
source.description:
The Draft Motor Vehicles (RVSF) Amendment Rules, 2026 propose expanded End-of-Life Vehicle definitions, stronger Vscrap-VAHAN integration, verified scrapping certificates, stricter equipment standards, and tougher compliance requirements for registered scrapping facilities.

The proposed changes aim to make vehicle scrapping more transparent, accountable, and environmentally compliant.

pack.topic: Land Document Verification & Legal Title Continuity for Coimbatore Plots
pack.source_script_insight: Just as vehicle scrapping rules require strict digital tracking, authorized certification, and tamper-proof documentation to prevent identity misuse, property land purchases in Coimbatore require verified, uncompromised document continuity and official digital EC records to prevent fraudulent ownership transfers.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Applying rigorous document tracking and digital verification principles to ancestral and converted agricultural plots across Coimbatore districts like Thudiyalur, Saravanampatti, and Vadavalli.
pack.core_takeaway: Never rely on physical token papers alone; cross-verify digital encumbrance records and legal title chains before buying Coimbatore land.

pack.gemini_video_prompt: Production-grade video prompt for OliveTree SafeBuy. COIMBATORE ONLY. EXACTLY 10 SECONDS. EXACTLY 7 SCENES. PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION-STYLE REAL FOOTAGE. 90%+ real-looking visuals captured with a real smartphone camera or gimbal, portrait 9:16 aspect ratio, no black bars, no blurred sidebars. Real-world visual environment in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: real document desks, sale deeds, encumbrance certificate (EC) paperwork, survey sketches, boundary stones, measuring tape, and open plots. Motion graphics allowed only as tiny minimalist text overlays over real footage. NO toon animation, NO cartoon, NO flat 2D explainer, NO white-background infographic, NO glossy corporate motion graphics, NO game-like 3D render, NO plastic CGI, NO floating documents, NO fake futuristic cities. Natural Tamil Nadu daylight, physically believable textures, dust, paper fibers, ink, road surfaces, shadows, and vegetation. Scene 1: Close-up of real land sale deeds and EC documents on a wooden desk. Scene 2: Finger pointing at a digital land records portal on a laptop. Scene 3: Inspector reviewing historical legal title papers. Scene 4: Surveyor measuring a vacant plot in a Coimbatore suburb. Scene 5: Tablet screen displaying official portal verification checkmarks. Scene 6: Stamping a verified title deed. Scene 7: Wide shot of a verified plot with evaluation board. NEGATIVE PROMPT: Animation, cartoon, 3D render, CGI, whiteboard explainer, corporate vector graphics, futuristic elements, floating objects, blurred sidebars, landscape mode, non-Tamil Nadu locations.
